snippet.title: Godot Showreel Submission | Adventure Awaits in The Secret of the Golden Key
snippet.description:
Pigeon Post Games submission for the Godot 2024 Showreel. The game featured is our visual novel made entirely in the Godot Engine named, Adventure Awaits in The Secret of the Golden Key!

Get updates on our social media!

Bluesky - https://bsky.app/profile/pigeonpostgames.bsky.social
Discord  - https://discord.gg/MKPcybpYdh
Mailing List - https://signup.pigeonpostgames.com/

Help us bring Adventure Awaits to life on Kickstarter:

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/pigeonpostgames/adventure-awaits-in-the-secret-of-the-golden-key

#godot #visualnovel #cozygames
